title: omaframe wireframe
description: Schema for .omaframe.json wireframe files (plan.md sections 3.2 and 4.4, Appendix C). A fixed cell grid with stacked sparse layers, plus optional parametric widgets and a dark/light preview hint.

grid.description: Fixed cell grid. 1 cell = 1 terminal character cell.

layers.description: Stacked layers, bottom first (index 0 = bottom). Suggested default: [Background, Frames, Text].

cells.description: Sparse storage: only non-transparent cells are listed.

ch.description: One character (a base char plus at most one combining mark / variation selector). Null and space are never stored: they are transparent.

fg.description: Foreground color: Omarchy ANSI index color0-color15.

widgets.description: Optional parametric widget entities (plan.md section 4.4). Resize/relabel source of truth; layers hold the baked cells used for text export.

kind.description: Widget kind, e.g. button, input, checkbox, progress, panel, tabs.

style.description: Style variant, e.g. default, rounded, checked, focused.

preview.description: Preview hint. Flips the canvas background surface only; wireframe fg indices never change.

activeLayer.description: Optional paint-target layer index (bottom-first). Absent in older files, which load with the top layer active; out-of-range values clamp to the top.
